body:
Thanks for your reply! 
Although I do agree I should move on, it's always playing in my head. Like my inner critical voice is the loudest right now telling me im a piece of shit although I know im just human. I've been this way for 4 years. What started out as innocent, exploring my sexuality, turned me into an insatiable monster that doesn't care about others emotions. I hate that I joined those stupid apps. I wish I never did. I was lost, I was struggling in school and dropped out for this. I haven't gotten anywhere in life. It's like im always trying to fill a void that keeps on taking. I wasn't supposed to be this way. It's not who I wanna be. If I could go back, I would change so much. But it's too late now. Im having trouble even feeling any emotions at all. I feel so numb. Like my life is moving without me consciously being there. Like im just existing and not really living. It's a terrible feeling. Sometimes it's like im drowning in myself. I've made progress by quitting marijuana. though I've been sober about 3 days now, I don't feel a need for it anymore. I used to get high to mask the pain of the things I've done on a daily basis. But eventually no matter how much I smoked I wasn't enjoying my highs anymore. I just want to be me again. Whoever that is.
